jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - International clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected Belgian boutique advisory firm founded by two former lawyers from leading international law firms. The organization supports high-profile prestigious clients and their families throughout every stage of their personal and professional journey.

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

With a close-knit team of around 10-15 professionals, the company offers an entrepreneurial environment where quality, trust, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Advise and assist clients on a wide range of legal matters.
• Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
• Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
• Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
• Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
• Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
• Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
• Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
• Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
• Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Belgian Master's degree in Law 
• Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Fluent in Dutch & English
• Proactive and hands-on personality.
• Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
• Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

• An ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
• A proactive attitude and a desire to learn and grow professionally.
• Organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
• Proficiency in English, Dutch & French;

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Your profile

• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills. 
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.  
 
• Good understanding of English. 
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments. 
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data. 
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

The role ensures accurate data management, timely processing of purchase orders, and effective coordination between suppliers, warehouse, and internal teams to maintain efficient material flow and stock availability.

The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector.

Description

• Provide day-to-day support to the team manager.

•  Degree in Office Management or similar,
• Relevant assistant experience is a must.

Do you like working accurately and enjoy a practical job? For the same family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.

- Handle parts weighing up to 10 kg.

- You speak and understand English. 

- You are comfortable with standing work and handling parts up to 10 kg. 

- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately. 

- You are looking for a full-time position and work in a precise and structured way.

Do you enjoy variety and like to get things done? For a family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a versatile warehouse worker who can be flexibly deployed across different departments and enjoys taking on a variety of tasks.

Do you enjoy working with metal and have an eye for detail?
 

We are looking for a Warehouse Operator for a company in Lokeren. 

You will be responsible for checking, preparing and processing returned metal machine components. You will work daytime hours in a technical working environment with a varied range of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Sort and visually inspect returned metal machine components for defects. 

- Check technical drawings and verify that all parts are complete.

- You have an interest in mechanics and metalworking.

Our client is a well-established global technology and manufacturing organization with over a century of industry expertise. The company develops innovative commercial equipment and intelligent embedded control systems used by businesses and institutions worldwide.

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using C programming for electronic control systems.
• Develop reliable and efficient software solutions for next-generation embedded products.
• Create and execute test plans and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate firmware on prototypes and production units.

• Optimize communication and interaction between embedded systems, peripherals, and control components.
• Work extensively with embedded interfaces and peripherals, including UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, timers, and interrupts.
• Support new product development initiatives, feature enhancements, and product releases.
• Manage firmware revisions, documentation, and engineering change activities.

• Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded systems.
